description: Newest entries of a feed, the same as the /feed endpoint, ordered by `listed`: when the entry became news here (its publish date, or later if it reached us late or turned critical later). `filter`: critical = in CISA KEV, or CISA SSVC exploitation "active", or CVSS 9+ in a listed technology (WordPress plugins and themes excepted; WordPress itself counts), or CVSS 7+ with EPSS ≥ 0.1; kev = in CISA KEV (ordered by date added). `listed_since` keeps entries whose `listed` is at or after an ISO date or timestamp; with `filter` kev alone the cut is the KEV day, which is what that list sorts by. `kev_added_since` keeps entries CISA added to KEV on or after that UTC day, and orders the list by that date unless `listed_since` is also set. An entry must match any value of a field and every field given.

kev_added_since.description: ISO date or timestamp. Only entries CISA added to KEV on or after that UTC day. Orders the list by that date unless `listed_since` is also set. Page with `cursor` to read the whole window.

listed_since.description: ISO date or timestamp. Only entries whose `listed` is at or after it. With `filter` kev alone, the list is ordered by the KEV date and the cut is that day.

vendor.description: Vendor or product name, matched from the start of a word, e.g. "fortinet" or "exchange server".
